config.title: md2pdfX
config.chromePath: Path to Chrome, Chromium or Edge. Empty: search the puppeteer cache and the system, download chrome-headless-shell if nothing is found.
config.extraCss: CSS file applied on top of the built-in styles. Relative paths resolve from the workspace folder.
config.outputDirectory: Folder for PDF files. Empty: next to the Markdown file. Relative paths resolve from the workspace folder.
config.theme.vectorheart: Black and white with an acid-lime accent, 45° cuts, monospace headings.
config.watermark: Text in the middle of the page footer, e.g. `CONFIDENTIAL`. Empty: no watermark.
config.theme.gost: Russian official documents per GOST R 7.0.97-2025: 30/10/20/20 mm margins, 14 pt, 1.25 cm indent, page number centered at the top from page 2, black and white.
command.exportBook: Export as Book to PDF (with linked files)
config.align: Text alignment. Code and tables stay left-aligned.
config.sections: Where sections (`##` headings) start. Continuous leaves less empty space on pages.
config.sections.page: Each section on a new page
